title: QuickSuite Widget Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the generic QuickSuite embedding widget. Defines navigation structure, branding, session management, filters, and feature flags.

apiEndpoint.description: Backend API Gateway endpoint URL for embed URL generation

navigation.description: Navigation tabs defining the widget UI structure. Each property key is the tab identifier.

label.description: Display label for the navigation tab

icon.description: Icon identifier (emoji or icon name) for the navigation tab

hidden.description: When true, the tab is not rendered in the navigation bar

type.description: Tab type: dashboard for embedded analytics, chat for generative Q&A

mobileShowSubNav.description: When false, hides the secondary sub-navigation bar on mobile viewports

subItems.description: Secondary navigation entries within this tab, each mapping to a specific dashboard sheet

icon.description: Icon (emoji or name) displayed in the sidebar for this sub-item

sheetId.description: QuickSight sheet ID within the dashboard

filters.description: IDs of the app filters enabled on this sheet (references filters[].id). Omit to enable all filters. Selections are preserved across sheets that share a filter.

session.description: Session management settings for embed URL caching and expiration

expirationMinutes.description: Duration in minutes before a cached embed URL expires and must be refreshed

branding.description: Visual branding configuration for the host page and widget UI

appName.description: Application name displayed in the top bar (e.g., 'Artisan Furnishings')

appIcon.description: Emoji or short text displayed as the app logo (e.g., '🪑')

tagline.description: Subtitle shown below/beside the app name in the top bar

primaryColor.description: Primary color (6-digit hex) used for sidebar, navigation backgrounds

secondaryColor.description: Secondary color (6-digit hex) used for accents, active states

logoUrl.description: URL to a logo image displayed in the top bar (max height 32px)

datasetIdentifier.description: Default QuickSight dataset identifier used by app-level filters (the DataSetIdentifier the dashboard references). Individual filters may override this via their own 'dataSetIdentifier'.

filters.description: App-level filter controls rendered above the dashboard. Each filter applies a QuickSight SDK filter group (addFilterGroups/updateFilterGroups/removeFilterGroups) to a real dataset column — no dashboard parameter is required.

id.description: Unique filter identifier, referenced by a sub-item's 'filters' array to enable it on that sheet

label.description: Display label for the filter control

column.description: Dataset column name to filter on via the SDK filter-group API

type.description: Control type: multiselect (checkbox category filter), single (single-value category filter), or daterange (start/end date TimeRangeFilter)

dataSetIdentifier.description: Optional per-filter dataset identifier override (defaults to the top-level 'datasetIdentifier')

parameterName.description: Deprecated. Legacy QuickSight dashboard parameter name (parameter-based filtering). Prefer 'column' with the SDK filter-group approach.

allLabel.description: Label for the 'show all' option (category filters only)

min.description: Optional minimum ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for daterange filters; bounds the date inputs and the 'Full range' shortcut

max.description: Optional maximum ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for daterange filters; bounds the date inputs and the 'Full range' shortcut

presets.description: Optional relative presets for daterange filters (defaults to Last 7/30 days and Last 3/12 months)

n.description: Number of units back from today

options.description: List of filter option values (category filters only; omit for daterange)

chat.description: Configuration for the QuickChat agent panel

agentId.description: QuickSight Agent ID for the embedQuickChat fixedAgentId option

panelTitle.description: Title displayed in the chat panel header

toggleLabel.description: Label on the top-bar chat toggle button

auth.description: Optional Cognito authentication. When present, viewers must log in via the Cognito Hosted UI.

chatEnabled.description: When true, the chat tab and chat panel are active

chatUserPoolSize.description: Number of pre-provisioned QuickSight reader users for chat rotation

containerId.description: HTML element ID of the container div where the widget renders
